# 每日自动备份到 GitHub — hermesAI- 仓库
set -e

DATE=$(date +%Y-%m-%d)

git pull origin main -q 2>/dev/null

mkdir -p "hermes/${DATE}"

      /home/admin/.hermes/skills/ \
      /home/admin/.hermes/cron/ \
      /home/admin/.hermes/memory* \
      "hermes/${DATE}/" 2>/dev/null || true

git push "https://xinghailiuli:${GH_TOKEN}@github.com/xinghailiuli/hermesAI-.git" main 2>&1
